g.text: How do people spend their time?

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start
text.tspan: Average time spent in a 24-hour day by people aged 15 to 64,

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start
text.tspan: according to each country's most recent time-use survey in the OECD

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start
text.tspan: database over the period 2010–2024. Activities are grouped into

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start
font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #858585

g.text: Data source: OECD Time Use Database (2026)

text.style: font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #858585
font-weight: 700; font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #858585
font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #858585
font-weight: 700; font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #858585
font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #858585

font-weight: 700; font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #858585
font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #858585

g.text: Averages cover everyone aged 15 to 64, on weekdays and weekends alike. Days and

text.style: font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #858585

g.text: people with no paid work or study count as zero hours of it. Unpaid work also includes religious

text.style: font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #858585

g.text: and civic activities, and time the OECD doesn't assign to another category, including some

text.style: font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #858585
